name: How long does fence stability restoration take?

mainEntity.name: How long does fence stability restoration take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of fence stability restoration depends on the project's scope. Minor repairs involving a few posts might take less than a day, while more extensive projects, such as replacing several sections or addressing significant foundational issues, could take a few days. We provide an estimated timeline with your project proposal after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Restoration time varies by project scope; minor repairs can be completed in less than a day, while extensive work may take several days.
